sampleSizeRationale: 640 fresh seed clusters provide approximately 90% normal-approximation power for a one-sided alpha=0.05 test of mean loss below 0.03 when the true mean is 0.028; the run is fixed-size and is not extended according to interim outcomes.
decisionRule: H3 replication passes only if the one-sided 95% seed-cluster bootstrap upper bound for utility loss is at most 0.03 and every two-sided 95% paired seed-cluster interval for the minimum-service contrast is strictly above zero.
estimand: Each seed is one independent cluster; the nine skew-by-supply settings are paired repeated conditions within seed.
stoppingRule: Run exactly 640 fresh seeds. Retain failures and do not add seeds after inspecting outcomes.
scope: Prospectively specified post-review replication; independent of the 30-seed development campaign and historical holdout.
